originalTitle: Coastal Metropolis Implements Sponge City Architecture to Mitigate Tidal Flooding
originalContent: Urban planning authorities in a major delta region have completed a multi-billion dollar infrastructure initiative incorporating permeable pavements and subterranean retention reservoirs. The bio-swale network is engineered to absorb extreme precipitation events driven by changing storm patterns. Initial environmental monitoring confirms reduced surface runoff and improved aquifer recharge rates.
